# the paths that run .github/workflows/fuzz.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order
# (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# fuzz run on a change that alters it
# fuzz/**: targets, seeds, fuzz/Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock (fuzz/ is its own workspace, so
# the root Cargo.lock is not read)
**/src/**
fuzz/**
# fuzz/Cargo.toml depends on alice-lol by path, alice-lol on alice-lol-macro by path, and
# cargo loads the root manifest as the workspace of both
Cargo.toml
alice-lol/Cargo.toml
alice-lol-macro/Cargo.toml
# include_str! in alice-lol/src/lib.rs
alice-lol/lol.gbnf
# the check step reads the run log with this script
scripts/fuzz_runs.py
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/fuzz.yml
.github/actions/**
.github/paths/fuzz.txt
